definitions.explanation: The level of education between elementary school and high school in Japan, typically for students aged 12-15 (grades 7-9).

examples.japanese: {中学|ちゅうがく}は{三年間|さんねんかん}です。
examples.english: Middle school lasts for three years.

examples.japanese: {息子|むすこ}は{今年|ことし}{中学|ちゅうがく}に{入学|にゅうがく}した。
examples.english: My son entered middle school this year.

examples.japanese: {中学|ちゅうがく}の{時|とき}、{英語|えいご}を{習|なら}い{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: I started learning English when I was in middle school.

notes:
Short form of {中学校|ちゅうがっこう}. In Japan, {中学|ちゅうがく} covers three years (ages 12-15) and is the final stage of compulsory education.

JAPANESE SCHOOL SYSTEM:
・{小学校|しょうがっこう} (elementary school): 6 years
・{中学校|ちゅうがっこう} (middle school): 3 years
・{高校|こうこう} (high school): 3 years
・{大学|だいがく} (university): 4 years

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{中学|ちゅうがく}に{入|はい}る/に{入学|にゅうがく}する (to enter middle school)
・{中学|ちゅうがく}を{卒業|そつぎょう}する (to graduate from middle school)
